sources: Esri World_Imagery at the pin with the catalog's site points

values.note: Forest Service: parking spurs 20-30 ft, 'maximum RV/trailer length is 22 feet'. The recreation.gov catalog lists spurs of 20-35 ft (two 20, one 22, one 25, two 30, one 35). Two vehicles or one RV per site.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/happy-meadows-campground ('Parking spurs are 20-30 feet with a maximum trailer length of 22 feet'; 'The maximum RV/trailer length is 22 feet') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233206 ('Happy Meadows offers seven reservable RV campsites') + catalog 233206 (Max Vehicle Length per site), read 2026-10-28

hookups.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233206 (notice 'No RV hookups are available'; catalog: all seven STANDARD NONELECTRIC), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Drinking water from a hand pump. Pack in, pack out: no trash service.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/happy-meadows-campground ('Vault toilet(s)'; 'Potable water is available at this site. A hand pump is available') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233206 (notice 'this is a PACK IN - PACK OUT facility'), read 2026-10-28

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/happy-meadows-campground ('This campground is open mid-May to mid-October, weather dependent'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: All seven sites are reservable until 5 days before arrival; sites not reserved by then go first-come (occupy the same night; pay at the fee tube).

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233206 (notice 'Reservations are available up to 5 days prior to arrival date. Sites not reserved 5 days before become available on a first come - first serve (FF) bases'; rules maxConsecutiveStay 14) + /rates (2026 Peak Season 2026-05-15 to 2026-10-11) + FS page ('No more than a 14-night consecutive stay'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: recreation.gov 2026: $25 a standard site, $31 a premium site. The Forest Service page says $24 / $29. Two vehicles or one RV included; third vehicle $11-12.

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233206/rates (2026 Peak Season: 'RV NONELECTRIC': 25, premium variant 31) + FS page ('$24 fee per site for overnight camping or $29 fee for premium site'), read 2026-10-28

note: Pike NF campground at 7,900 ft on the South Platte River, ~2 mi north of Lake George via CR 77 (Tarryall Rd) and CR 112; most sites sit along a bend of the river. Bear-country food-storage order in effect. --Claude
summary: FS page + recreation.gov: confirmed 7 sites, no hookups, vault toilet, hand-pump water. Max length 40 -> 22 (FS: 'maximum RV/trailer length is 22 feet'; CRITERIA flag). Fees 24/24 -> 25/31 (recreation.gov 2026; FS says $24/$29). Booking: reservable until 5 days out then first-come (after_cutoff), 14-night max, reservation season 05-15..10-11; season mid-May - mid-October (note). Riverfront confirmed. Note rewritten (wrong district and length removed).
flags: CRITERIA: the Forest Service posts a 22-ft limit - 'Parking spurs are 20-30 feet with a maximum trailer length of 22 feet' and 'The maximum RV/trailer length is 22 feet' (https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/happy-meadows-campground). Under 23 ft; applies to EKKO (cf. Chapman Reservoir, p3-173). Conflicts: the FS gives spurs of 20-30 ft, the recreation.gov catalog 20-35 ft (sites 001/003 30 ft, 005 35 ft), recreation.gov's description calls them 'seven reservable RV campsites'. Stored 40 was note-derived and has no source.
Fee conflict: recreation.gov 2026 $25 standard / $31 premium; FS page $24 / $29. Recorded recreation.gov's.
Missing phone: the FS page gives the South Park Ranger District, 719-836-2031 (not South Platte RD, as the old note said). recreation.gov gives the concessionaire's line (661) 702-1420.
Website is recreation.gov only; the FS page is https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/happy-meadows-campground.

Waterfront (stored riverfront) stands: on imagery sites 001, 002, 006, 007 and 008 sit ~10-30 m from the South Platte River on the inside of a bend, open ground between. The river is the South Platte main stem (recreation.gov: 'situated along the South Platte River'), not the South Fork.
Operator: concessionaire-run (FS pass wording; recreation.gov contact @goexplorus.com). Ownership federal stands.
Pin 39.0146,-105.3623 is 71 m from the catalog site centroid (at the entrance road). OK. recreation.gov's facility point (39.0377,-105.6074) is ~21 km away - a recreation.gov data error.
